subject: Channel listing orchestration: CloudScale CPPO activation & marketplace SKUs
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudscale.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudScale Legal <legal@cloudscale.io>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing - CPPO enablement request

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to move forward with an AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO) listing for CloudScale as the reseller for our joint pilot customers. High-level asks:
- Confirm required entity mapping and invoice routing fields for AWS (we have multiple entities in EU/US)
- Confirm expected SKU/usage reporting cadence so we can reconcile billing to our downstream customers
- Provide the CPPO DocuSign packet that Redwood expects countersigned

Attached is a preliminary SKU mapping we started (sku_mapping_cloudscale.csv) and a draft price sheet (pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx). Can your team confirm the SKUs that must be present in the CPPO CSV export and any mapping rules (e.g., unitMultiplier, billingPeriod)?

We also need a short timeline: ideally get CPPO live for two pilot deals by 2028-08-15. Who from Redwood should own the AWS-side submission and who will be our contact for settlement questions?

Thanks,
Anna
Director, Channel Sales
CloudScale Resale

--- attachment: sku_mapping_cloudscale.csv (stub)
--- attachment: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (stub)

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudscale.io>, AWS PAM <aws-pam@amazon.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - CPPO enablement request

Anna — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (channel sales lead) for deal coordination, Camila (partnership ops) for CPPO intake, and Markus (billing/finance) for entity/invoice mapping.

Quick answers and next steps:
1) Redwood will own the AWS-side submission for the CPPO CSV, but CloudScale must provide an approved pricing matrix and the final entity legal names/tax IDs for invoice routing.
2) SKUs: Our marketplace team requires a SKU per billing unit. The attached sku_mapping looks close, but please add a column called "billingUnit" (tokens / vCPU-hours / seats) and confirm unitMultiplier. We'll return a validated CSV template.
3) Reporting: AWS publishes entitlement reports daily; Redwood reconciles monthly. Markus will outline the reconciliation cadence and the fields we need from CloudScale.
4) DocuSign: We maintain a CPPO order form that needs countersignature from CloudScale legal. I'll share the DocuSign link once we have the finalized pricing matrix.

Proposed timeline:
- By 2028-07-24: CloudScale provides finalized price + invoice entity info
- By 2028-07-26: Redwood validates SKU CSV and populates marketplace submission
- By 2028-07-28: CPPO DocuSign issued to CloudScale
- By 2028-08-10: Target AWS approval / activation for first pilot

Ben — can you confirm availability to lead the intake call with Anna and AWS PAM tomorrow? Markus — please attach the list of invoice fields we require (legal name, remit-to entity, tax id, billing contact).

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudscale.io>, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: AWS PAM <aws-pam@amazon.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - CPPO enablement request

Anna — happy to run the intake. Proposed 30-min call tomorrow 2028-07-24 09:00 PT to walk through the pricing matrix and SKU mapping. I invited Camila to take notes for the submission packet.

Agenda:
- Confirm final pricing rows and billingUnit mapping
- Walk the SKU CSV and column expectations (unitMultiplier, currency, skuCode)
- Entity mapping: legal name, remit-to, tax ID, support email
- Who signs DocuSign and timeline

If that time doesn't work for AWS PAM, we'll shift — please reply with availability.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: AWS PAM <aws-pam@amazon.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Anna Lopez <anna@cloudscale.io>, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-24T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - CPPO enablement request

Ben/Anna — confirmed for 07/24 09:00 PT (Iappropriate timezones adjusted). Quick notes from the AWS side:
- For CPPO submissions we need a single invoice entity to map to the Private Offer. If CloudScale has multiple downstream entities, you can still route invoices via marketplace entitlement mapping, but AWS requires the marketplace subscription owner to be one legal entity.
- Please ensure the SKU codes are unique and avoid special characters.
- We recommend including a short justification string per SKU for the AWS intake team (e.g., "tokens-standard-1k: per-1k-token unit").

I'll help surface any missing fields during intake. Looking forward to the call.

— AWS PAM

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudscale.io>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - CPPO enablement request

Folks — following our call, attached is the validated SKU CSV template (we populated CloudScale entries and normalized billingUnit). Markus attached the invoice_field_requirements.xlsx to the HubSpot deal.

Action items for CloudScale (due 2028-07-26 EOD):
- Confirm final prices in pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx and mark the signing contact for DocuSign
- Confirm remit-to legal entity (single entity for subscription owner) and provide tax ID
- Reply with any special SKUs that need a usageMultiplier != 1

Irene — once Anna confirms, I'll trigger the DocuSign envelope and attach the CPPO order form.

Anna
